MongoDB Storage Design
MongoDB is used to store uploaded documents and extracted information.
Each uploaded document stores the following metadata.
• Document ID
• Original Filename
• Workspace ID
• Page Count
• Author
• Keywords
• File Size
• Upload Timestamp
The extracted pages are stored separately for efficient processing during chunk gen-
eration.
